scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "bun run --filter server dev" "bun run --filter web dev"
scripts.tunnel: docker compose up -d db && VITE_API_BASE_URL= bun run build && concurrently --kill-others -n build,api,tunnel "VITE_API_BASE_URL= bun run --filter web build --watch" "HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3001 bun run --filter server dev" "bin/cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://127.0.0.1:3001"
